info.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Zoku Koukousei-hen
info.synopsis: Seguito di "Cardfight!! Vanguard (2018)". - La nuova stagione, tratta dal manga di Akira Itou, racconta una nuova storia con Aichi e Kai che tornano a ricoprire il ruolo di protagonisti principali. Assieme a loro, tornano anche altri personaggi amati dal pubblico come Misaki Tokura, Kamui Katsuragi e Ren Suzugamori.

episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Ibuki loses the peace gained from the battle with the Wandering Star Brandt, and is overcome with guilt. Ibuki receives an invitation to the Tatsunagi Mansion, where he is met by Nome Tatsunagi, the new head of the Tatsunagi foundation.

tvdb.title: Greion's Whisper

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Ibuki's heart rejects the power of Deletors out of fear. Discarding his deck, Ibuki decides to quit Vanguard for good. However, he is stopped by Leon, who coincidentally paid a visit to the Tatsunagi Mansion.

tvdb.title: The Last Delete End
tvdb.synopsis: Kouji Ibuki refuses to use the power of the Deletors with all of his heart. He decides to discard his deck and quit Vanguard, but Leon Soryu appears to try and stop him.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: To make up for his own sins with the new power he obtained, Ibuki appears before the person he had deleted, Tetsu. He then challenges Asaka to a fight, to join the Fukuhara High School VG Club's Koshien team as the anchor.

tmdb.title: Episodio 9

tvdb.title: Ruler's Resolution
tvdb.synopsis: Kouji Ibuki, who had gained a new power, appears before Tetsu Shinjou, whom he had deleted previously. Ibuki wanted to fight Asaka Narumi in order to gain a spot within Fukuhara's team for the Vanguard Koshien.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The four schools advancing to the Vanguard Koshien semifinals have been decided, and they are Miyaji, Hitsue, Fukuhara, and Harumi. And the first match is Fukuhara VS Harumi. With their reputation on the line, which high school will proceed to the finals?

tmdb.title: Episodio 10
tmdb.synopsis: The four schools advancing to the Vanguard Koshien semifinals have been decided, and they are Miyaji, Hitsue, Fukuhara, and Harumi. And the first match is Fukuhara VS Harumi. With their reputation on the line, which high school will proceed to the finals?

tvdb.title: Stand up!! The Vanguard Koshien!!
tvdb.synopsis: Time has passed, and the Miyaji Academy, Hitsue, Fukuhara, and Harumi Vanguard Clubs have all advanced to the semi-finals. The first match is between Fukuhara and Harumi. Which school will win and proceed to the finals?

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The next semifinals is Miyaji VS Hitsue. However, Kai goes missing on the day of the fight. Without completely recovering from being deleted, will Kai make it in time to the venue?

tvdb.title: Welcome Back, Kai
tvdb.synopsis: It's the finals, between Miyaji Academy and Fukuhara. Aichi Sendou entrusts the last fight to Naoki Ishida, and faces off against Ren Suzugamori during the first match. While Ren enjoys the fight, his PSYqualia activates, showing him the destiny he had lost.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: The finals is Miyaji VS Fukuhara. Leaving the anchor match to Naoki, Aichi and Ren face off in the fourth match. As Ren goes all out to enjoy the fight, his PSYqualia reveals a destiny that should've been lost.

tvdb.title: Memories Neither from the Past nor Future
tvdb.synopsis: It's the finals, between Miyaji Academy and Fukuhara. Aichi Sendou entrusts the last fight to Naoki Ishida, and faces off against Ren Suzugamori during the first match. While Ren enjoys the fight, his PSYqualia activates, showing him the destiny he had lost.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Vanguard Koshien has Naoki and Ibuki facing off for the anchor match! It's a fight that will decide the victor. As things heat up for Naoki, he catches a glimpse of Kourin.

tmdb.title: Episodio 13
tmdb.synopsis: Vanguard Koshien has Naoki and Ibuki facing off for the anchor match! It's a fight that will decide the victor. As things heat up for Naoki, he catches a glimpse of Kourin.

tvdb.title: Decisive Fight!!
tvdb.synopsis: It's the final match of the Vanguard Koshien, between Naoki Ishida and Kouji Ibuki! Because of Naoki's overwhelming and passionately burning feelings during the fight, Kourin Tatsunagi herself has an intense feeling welling up inside of her.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: No matter the distance, the souls led by fate cross paths once more. Kourin invites Miyaji Academy, the winner of Vanguard Koshien, to an exhibition match.

tvdb.title: Welcome to the CF Club
tvdb.synopsis: No matter how far away, the roads of destiny intersect with guidance from the soul. Kourin Tatsunagi appeals for an exhibition match against Miyaji Academy, the school whose club won the Vanguard Koshien.

related.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Shinemon-hen
related.plot: Seguito di "Cardfight!! Vanguard: Zoku Koukousei-hen". - Questa è la storia di "Nitta Shinemon", il futuro manager di Card Capital. 10 anni prima della riunione di Aichi Sendou e Toshiki Kai, il negozio di carte gestito dalla famiglia Tokura "Card Capital" stava fallendo. Successivamente arriva il tentativo di rilevare il negozio da Esuka Hibino, proprietaria di un importante negozio di carte. Al fine di proteggere Card Capital, Nitta Shinemon si elegge come "Manager autoproclamato!".

Yu-yu è un ragazzo che vive a Kanazawa, nella provincia di Kaga. Ha 15 anni e frequenta la terza media. Ha la capacità di percepire i sentimenti degli altri, ma è turbato dal fatto che non può dire di no quando gli viene chiesto. Un giorno, Yu-yu a causa dei dissidi con sua sorella scappò di casa ma viene salvato da Megumi Okura. Quest'ultimo invita Yu-yu in un parco di divertimenti notturno chiamato "Wonder Hill" dove i suoi amici si incontrano per giocare a Vanguard ogni sera.
